description: This file defines the 'Raw' class, a Drupal plugin for extracting raw URL path components as argument defaults in Views. It manages options for path component index and alias usage, and provides methods for argument retrieval and cache settings.

classes.name: Raw
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that provides raw URL path component as argument default, with cache and alias options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes alias manager and current path objects.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines plugin options for path index and alias usage.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for plugin options.

methods.name: getArgument
methods.description: Retrieves the specified path component from the current URL, optionally using alias.

methods.name: getCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Returns cache max age as permanent.
